bountyHunter.name: Bounty Hunter
bountyHunter.description: Your reputation preceded you. He was waiting.

rivalDescription: He fights with the rage of someone who's waited a long time.
rivalAmbush: RIVAL — {{name}} was waiting for you on arrival.
stalkerEscalated: ⚠ {{name}} — threat level {{level}}. They're getting more dangerous.
avengingStalkerAmbush: ☠ {{name}} was waiting for you on arrival. They want the fragment.
raphazarusWarriorJournal: {{name}} intercepted me. Raphazarus figured out I'm gathering the fragments — and unleashed his warriors.
raphazarusWarriorAmbush: ☠ {{name}} — Raphazarus sent his warriors after you.

folieCrisis.blackoutJournal: Blackout. I woke up somewhere else, blood that isn't mine on my hands. Credits gone.
folieCrisis.hungerJournal: The hunger took over before I could feed properly. I hurt myself regaining control.
folieCrisis.noticedJournal: Someone saw me — the look they gave me won't be forgotten.
folieCrisis.noticedMsg: 🩸 CRISIS — someone noticed something strange about you. -10 rep.

rayaneFuelHeads: 🪙 HEADS — +2 fuel found all at once.
rayaneFuelTails: 🪙 TAILS — found nothing, and a fall in the debris. -5 HP.
fuelNotFound: Found nothing this time. The reserves are dry.
tutorialDatapad: ◈ The contact hands you the promised datapad. It lights up: "The void hides four Nexus Fragments. Gather them and the sector is yours." — NEXUS TRACKER REVEALED.
chainAvailable: 📋 Follow-up available — see Look for Work
conquestMessage: CONQUEST — The Nexus is restored, but space remains to be conquered. Complete every objective and finish what you started.
tournamentRound: TOURNAMENT — ROUND {{round}}/10  |  +50 HP recovered. Stamina full.
tournamentWin: TOURNAMENT COMPLETE! +{{loot}} cr, +60 reputation, legendary weapon: {{weapon}}
victoryJournalBoss: I defeated {{enemy}} at {{station}}. An opponent who deserved respect.
fledJournal: I fled the fight against {{enemy}} at {{station}}. Surviving is a win too.
lastBreath: ★ LAST BREATH — You survive at 1 HP. This won't happen again.
capturedJournal: I was captured after the fight against {{enemy}} at {{station}}. 3 days behind bars.
fragmentRetaken: {{name}} caught up with me and took back {{boss}}'s fragment. They're not hunting me anymore — they got what they wanted.
shipTowed: 💥 Your ship completely gives out. A shady tow crew fishes you out — {{fee}} cr in "rescue fees", -8 rep.
